start.text: Sameer's friend? Good, good. Second-hand, but I keep them like my own - service record, new battery, tyres I'll argue about. This grey one: thirty-eight thousand. Outright, or EMI - six down, thirty-two hundred a month for ten months, deducted on your salary day.

haggle.text: Thirty-eight. Tell me why it should be less.

outright_done.text: Keys. Papers in the glovebox, RC transfer I'll do by Friday. Four litres in the tank - the bunk next door is mine too, so don't go anywhere else. Ride slow the first week; the clutch-less ones fool you.

emi_deal.text: Six thousand received. Ten more on ten salary days - I know Sameer's company pays on the first, I know everyone's company. Keys. Four litres in the tank; the bunk next door is mine too.

walked.text: Think, think. The grey one will be here. Or it won't - Tuesdays are busy.

think.text: Take your time. Walk once around, look at the red one also. Everyone looks at the red one and buys the grey one.

again.text: Decided? Outright we can talk; EMI is six down, thirty-two hundred a month.

owner.text: How is she running? Any noise from the back, bring it Sunday, no charge. Fuel is next door.

emi_customer.text: EMI customer! Don't worry, I don't call. The bank calls. Petrol is next door, tell him Noor sent you - same price, but he will smile.

paid_off.text: Ten out of ten. She is fully yours now. Come for the service, not for the EMI.
